text: [ff6464]ERROR: You have not accepted the required quest.[ffffff]
Select one from Sherry, Cersier and Tenert and\nask if they have found a clue!
You may be able to reach the strange shadow\nby following the correct clues!
EVENT BATTLE\nMonsters got on the boat!
A-Adventurer! I found this at the place where\nsomething was blinking... This should be...
...Right. If the crystal is the same as the one\nthat tormented us, the same kind of monster\nmay appear... We need to hurry.
...Right. If the crystal is the same as that\nmonster, it might have resurrected...\nWe need to hurry.
I found it in the bush where something was moving.\nI wonder what it is. Does it have something to do\nwith the strange shadow?
I found it in the bush where something was moving.\nI wonder what it is. Does it have something to do\nwith the monster?
...Hmm, yes. If there is another type of the\nmonster that afflicted us, we can't leave it as\nit is... For now, let's proceed.
...Hmm, yes. If the monster still exists,\nwe can't leave as it is... For now, let's proceed.
Hey! My hunch proved right!!\nLook at this. This should have something to do\nwith the strange shadow! I'm so sure!
Hey! My hunch proved right!!\nLook at this. This should have something to do\nwith the monster! I'm so sure!
Yea, that's the spirit!! We can't leave the\nmonster that is harmful to the Sakura trees!\nWe need to keep goin' and find it!
You got an ominous colored small crystal...\nIt looks like the crystals that absorbed\nenergy from Sherry and Cersier's trees...
The monsters that use the crystals may be\nnear here. You need to keep going and\nfind out whose crystal it is...
You got an ominous colored small crystal...\nIt's small but it looks like the crystals\nthat the monster was using...
The monster could be near here...\nYou need to keep going and find out who is using\nthe crystals...
You got a strange big feather...\nBut the monster that tormented Cersier and\nSherry's trees didn't have wings...
A new type of monsters could be lurking around\nhere. We need to keep going and confirm whose\nfeather it is...
You got a strange big feather...\nIt looks like the ones that the monster had...\nIt might be lurking around here.
The same kind of monster might be lurking around\nhere. You need to keep going and find out whose\nshell it is...
You got a huge shell... Come to think of it,\nthe monster that tormented Cersier and Sherry's\ntrees was covered with a shell like this...
The same kind of monster might be lurking around\nhere. You need to keep going and find out whose\nshell it is...
You got a huge shell... Come to think of it,\nthe monster that you fought the other day was\ncovered with a hard shell like this...
The monster could have resurrected and be lurking\naround here.  You need to keep going and find out\nwhose shell it is...
Oh? I saw something twinkling...\nI'm sorry. Looks like my eyes deceived me...
O...Oh? Was it just my imagination...?\nI apologize for wasting your time.\nSeems like it's not the monster...
Nothing, huh?! Sorry, my hunch has got old as\nwell. Not sure if it's the monster but I felt\nsomething was there...
I was sooooo scared!! They were not big like\nthe monster but it was horrifying to see that\nnumber of monsters. Thanks for saving me...
Oh... It was shocking. A lot of monsters attacked\nus all of a sudden... Wasn't it the monster that\nappeared the last time?
Phew... What was it?! They almost filled up\nthe houseboat... Well, it might have been a\ngod's warning to keep our guard up...
Are you in pain? Maybe stomachache...?
He's got serious seasick...\nIt's not good for him to continue sailing...
We have no other option but to stop exploring\nand go back to the dock...
Can you see something twinkling there?\nI don't know if it's related to the shadow but\nI think we need to check it. Let's go.
Can you see something twinkling there?\nI don't know if it's related to the monster but\nI think we need to check it. Let's go.
Oh, adventurer. I saw something moving there.\nWhat? Um, I'm not sure if it was the strange\nshadow... Anyway, let's go see it!
Oh, adventurer. I saw something moving there.\nWhat? Um, I'm not sure if it was the monster...\nAnyway, let's go see it!
Hey. Over there... Isn't something wrong?\nHm? Well, I didn't see anything.\nIt's just my hunch but...
I just can't help thinking about it.\nLet me go check that place. Okay?
H-How beautiful...\nWho can resist drinking in front of the beautiful\nscenery and ladies?
Let's start drinking!\nI've brought special liquor for it...
It flew away fast but it looked like the monsters\nthat were attacking Sherry and Cersier's trees.
Don't say... It was another monster that threatens\nSakura trees?!
What?! If that's true, our family trees in this\nworld will be in danger not only us!
Don't worry!! It might not be the monster.\nEven if it was, we have the adventurer here.\nWe'll take it down in a blink, right?
How can I say thank you enough...\nI appreciate it!
Ha ha, say thank you after we confirm if it's the\nmonster and defeat it. Okay, now let's chase it.\nCome on, houseboat!
It flew away in an instant, so the houseboat needs\nsome clues to chase it...
Let's follow the direction and find other clues!\nCome on, houseboat!
We have sailed the houseboat to the same direction\nbut there is nothing that looks like the shadow...
Hmm, I saw it flying away to here...\nAnyway, let's split and find clues.
They are shouting something.\nSounds like they found something, but what...?
Sailed the houseboat to the direction that\nSherry and Cersier said but there's nothing\nthat looks like the strange shadow.
Something is wrong. They told us that they saw it\naround here... Well, let's split and find clues.
